ImageDescription.value:
Scientific Name: Agrocybe aegerita Common Name: Agrocybe Certainty: not sure at all (notes) Location: Appalachians; Smokies; CabinCove Date: 20071119

This could just as well be a Galerina autumnalis -- they're all over these mountains just now -- but I swear these look quite different (see the other photo I uploaded a few minutes ago). Microscopically, the cellular structure of the pileus and texture of the spores should resolve the issue, but

me without my miscroscope...
